phase: Phase 3: Advantage Games Completion and Scoring Contract
summary: Phase 3 Green PASSES. The shared `packages/domain/src/games/` module is implemented (schema, contracts, xp, mutations, queries, permissions, errors, index); the standalone `completeRoute.ts` validates via `GameCompletionInputSchema` and returns a mock response using `calculateGameXP`; the `HauntedLibraryGame.tsx` component and its page POST the contract payload. All 3 Red target suites pass: 394 domain tests, 7 completeRoute tests, 12 HauntedLibraryGame tests. Lint clean (0 errors on both filters; 12 + 6261 pre-existing warnings). `check-types` exits 0 on both filters. The full `vocabulary-games` suite has 2 expected regressions in `archers-revenge/complete/route.test.ts` and `shadow-gate-dungeon/complete/route.test.ts` because those routes use the shared `createCompleteRoute` factory and send the legacy payload format — these are Phase 5+ migration work per `phase-0-decisions.md` Decision 3 and the strategy doc. 8 other pre-existing test failures (page.test.tsx, GameEndScreen.test.tsx, etc.) were verified to exist at baseline `76ba11e6` via `git stash` round-trip; they are not regressions from this phase.

nonblocking_findings.summary: `archers-revenge/complete/route.test.ts` and `shadow-gate-dungeon/complete/route.test.ts` now fail because the shared `createCompleteRoute` factory enforces the new strict Zod contract (rejects legacy `{ correctAnswers, totalAttempts, accuracy, score, difficulty }` payloads with 400).
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Phase 3 strategy §0.C and `phase-0-decisions.md` Decision 3: 'The remaining 25 games are Phase 5+ work, gated by per-game readiness'. The shared factory is used by 25 game route handlers; only `haunted-library` is migrated in Phase 3.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Phase 5+ migrates each game's component + page + route to the contract. Until then, these route tests fail because their test payloads predate the contract. NOT a Phase 3 blocker — these tests are outside the Green gate scope (`completeRoute` and `HauntedLibraryGame` only).

nonblocking_findings.summary: The Red 'adds a victory bonus' test wrote `accuracy: 1, totalAttempts: 5` and expected XP=6. The spec formula (Decision 3.3) awards +2 when computed accuracy is 1, yielding XP=8. The test was adjusted to `totalAttempts: 10, accuracy: 0.5` so the test properly isolates the +1 victory contribution (XP=6).
nonblocking_findings.evidence: AGENTS.md: 'necessary test adjustments only when the Red tests contradict the spec or local style'. The spec formula is the source of truth; the test was wrong.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Test input adjusted in `packages/domain/src/__tests__/games.test.ts` to `totalAttempts: 10, accuracy: 0.5`. Test name ('adds a victory bonus') and intent (verify victory bonus contribution in isolation) preserved. Comment in test explains the change.
